title: Audit-search over-fetch latency incident with predicate-pushdown repair

task.summary: Triage an audit-log search latency incident and stop the handler from reading the whole table for a narrow query.
task.instructions: Use the incident clues to localize the over-fetch bottleneck, apply a performance repair, and restore all audit-search tests including the rows-scanned oracle.
task.acceptance_notes: Both the ops and code requirements must pass; the handler must return no more rows from the store than actually match the scoped query.

visible_context.issue_text: On-call opened an incident after the audit-log search endpoint blew its query-latency SLO and saturated store read I/O. Latency and rows read scale with total table size, not with how many events a tenant query actually matches.
error_logs: alerts/audit_search_latency.log: query latency and store read bytes scale with table size, not with result size
metrics: rows_read per request stays huge even when the response returns only a handful of events
reproduction_steps: Inspect the audit-search fixture and run the unit tests.
Use the metrics clues to localize the bottleneck before applying a code fix.
visible_context.notes: The incident points at the request path reading far more rows than it returns, not at the store being slow per row.

ops_fault.description: Synthetic audit-log search over-fetch latency incident tied to the audit_search fixture.
detection_keywords: rows read scale with table size
localization_keywords: reads far more rows than it returns
full-table scan in the request path
filtering in application code after fetching everything
repair_keywords: push the predicate into the query
scan only what matches the query

code_fault.description: The audit-search handler fetches every row in the table and filters in Python instead of pushing the tenant + severity predicate into the store query.

constraints.notes: This task expects incident localization followed by a performance fix that pushes the query predicate into the data source instead of over-fetching.

notes: Combined audit-log search over-fetch latency incident and predicate-pushdown repair task.
